title: Calendar
nothing_hint: Add what is coming up, and the whole family sees it.
scope_only_hint: Moves to {{date}}. The repeat stays as it is.
scope_following: This one and the ones after
scope_following_hint: The repeat changes from now on. Next: {{date}}.
delete_one_confirm: Tap again to skip this one
error: That did not work. Please check the details and try again.
error_end_same: Choose an end time other than the start
edit_series_hint: Changes apply to the whole series.
feature_description: Shared family calendar with a Today card.
words_everyone: everyone, everybody, the whole family, whole family, the entire family, all of us, the whole household, whole household
cap_manage: Manage calendar subscriptions and the family feed
read_only_hint: This event comes from a subscribed calendar and cannot be changed here.
feeds_intro: Add the family calendar to your phone's own calendar app. It updates by itself and is read-only.
feeds_warning: Anyone who has the address can see these events, so keep it like a password. If it gets out, remove it below and make a new one.
feeds_outside_hint: This sends the family calendar out. To bring a calendar from outside in (holidays, school), ask whoever manages the family's calendars: they add it under Settings → Calendars & tags.
feeds_outside_manage: This sends the family calendar out. To bring a calendar from outside in (holidays, school), add it under
calendars_subtitle: Other calendars shown next to the family's, and the tags on events.
feeds_password_needed: Sign in with your password to create an address. A PIN on a shared device cannot make one.
feed_notes_hint: Titles, times and places are always included. Notes only if you turn this on.
feed_created_hint: It is shown only this once. Copy it now, then paste it into your calendar app as a subscription.
feed_howto: On iPhone: Settings, Calendar, Accounts, Add account, Other, Add subscribed calendar. On Android with Google Calendar: open calendar.google.com on a computer, Other calendars, From URL.
subs_intro: Show another calendar next to yours: school, public holidays, a club or work. The family sees its events, and nobody can change them here.
subs_warning: Addresses from Google or iCloud are secret. FamilyOS keeps them locked and never shows them again.
sub_url_hint: The address of a calendar to follow. It starts with https:// or webcal://; calendar apps may call it an ICS or subscription link.
sub_allow_local_warn: Only for a calendar inside your home network, such as on a NAS. This lets FamilyOS contact devices on your network. Leave it off for anything on the internet.
sub_new_url_hint: Leave empty to keep the current address ({{host}}). The stored address is never shown.
sub_error_unreachable: Could not reach the calendar. The events from before are kept.
sub_error_too_large: The calendar is too large (over 5 MB). The events from before are kept.
sub_error_not_calendar: The address did not return a calendar. The events from before are kept.
sub_error_blocked_address: The address points into a private network. Turn on the home network option if that is intended.
sub_error_bad_url: The address cannot be used. Press Edit and enter the calendar address again. The events from before are kept.
sub_error_http: The calendar's server answered with an error ({{status}}). The events from before are kept.
nothing_filtered: Nothing with these tags on this day.
tags_intro: Tags you put on events, like school, health or car. Renaming or deleting a tag changes every event that has it.
tags_none: No tags yet. Add one when you create an event.
tag_rename_hint: If another tag already has this name, the two are merged.
page_empty: Nothing planned in the next 7 days.
page_unavailable: The calendar cannot be reached right now.
discard_hint: What you typed here has not been saved.
draft_title_put_occurrence_back: Put one date of a repeating event back
setup_step_text: Or subscribe to a calendar you already use
words_end_time: back by, back at, back around, back before, home by, home at, until, till, ends at, ends by, end at, finishes at, finish at, finished by, over by, done by, returns at, returning at
